brief: Pécule: chaque paiement carte arrondi à l'euro supérieur, la différence part en épargne. Café 2,40 € arrondi à 3 €, 0,60 € épargnés sans y penser
Pécule: nouveau boost x2 double chaque arrondi (0,60 € devient 1,20 €), jusqu'à 1 095 € en un an
constraint: one strong diagonal organises the frame
mechanic: the thumbnail crop hides the punchline until opened

brief: Pécule: l'épargne de fin de mois ne marche jamais car il ne reste rien le 30; Pécule épargne pendant le mois, un peu à chaque paiement (arrondi à l'euro sup)
constraint: the key text is rotated 90 degrees
mechanic: a story with one moment that makes you hold your thumb

concept: Page de test à court d'encre: le mois imprimé ligne par ligne, l'encre noire du compte s'épuise avant le 30, la colonne cyan Pécule reste pleine
layout: printer test sheet: status line + CMYK patches, huge condensed question, 30-row decaying bar wedge with steady cyan column, answer set in the empty paper bottom right, promise + mono proof at foot
device: ink running out: solid bars turning to banding and missing nozzles; answer word 'rien.' printed streaked grey; rotated column label

concept: Arrondi au sens propre: top-down espresso on a bistro saucer cut like a tart, the 1/5 slice (0,60 € of 3 €) set aside on the marble
layout: headline top-left, huge saucer bleeding off left edge, slice set aside lower right with blue figure above it, sign-off bottom-right
device: procedural marble + crema (kit field), SVG rim lettering on a circle path, conic masks, dotted ghost outline; circles-only constraint

concept: Le ticket tamponné: giant thermal receipt on a zinc counter, violet rubber stamp BOOST ×2 as the hook, rows 2,40 → 3,00 → +0,60 +0,60 = 1,20, cumul 1 095 €
fonts: Martian Mono (wdth axis, double-width print), Alfa Slab One (stamp)
layout: one strong -15° diagonal receipt top-left to bottom-right, cropped bottom, stamp at counter-angle spilling onto the metal, two empty zinc triangles
device: thermal receipt + rubber stamp (kit ink filter), brushed zinc procedural field, zigzag torn edge, reverse-print band
